summary: Frontend-only test of 3 new 3D visual features: PropertyFlipCard hover flip on /properties, Mapbox GL 3D maps on /areas, /areas/chelsea and /properties/prototype-chelsea-residence, and PageHero parallax on / and /sell. All success criteria met: 3 results render, hover flip rotates .flip-inner to 180deg, back button + front anchor both link to /properties/<slug>, all three maps render mapboxgl-canvas with gold markers (3 on /areas, 1 on /areas/chelsea, 1 on property detail), popup on /areas contains VIEW PROPERTY link to /properties/prototype-chelsea-residence, no map-fallback shown, /sell has data-testid=parallax-bg, and no console errors on homepage or /sell.

issues: Popup title 'Chelsea Residence' visually overlaps the built-in mapbox '×' close button in the top-right of the popup (title text runs under/behind the close X). Consider adding right padding to the popup title or a wider popup max-width.

action_items: (Optional/low) Adjust .mapboxgl-popup-content padding-right so the title doesn't collide with the close X.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyFlipCard: hover-flip verified via computed transform matrix3d(-1,...,-1,...) == rotateY(180deg). Front face and back CTA both point to /properties/<slug> — good.

PropertyMap: 3 markers on /areas, marker click opens a single popup with escaped HTML including a working /properties/<slug> anchor. No fallback triggered, meaning NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN is correctly inlined at build time.
Only warnings surfaced were benign WebGL GPU-stall performance messages from the headless GL driver on /areas — not app errors.

NavigationControl: query for '.mapboxgl-ctrl-navigation' returned null in this Mapbox version (controls are '.mapboxgl-ctrl-group' containing zoom-in/zoom-out/compass). Visually the +/-/compass control is present (screenshot). Not a bug, just a selector-naming note for future tests.
seed_data_creation: None — used 3 seeded prototype properties returned by /api/properties.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For Mapbox nav control assertion, use '.mapboxgl-ctrl-group' (with children .mapboxgl-ctrl-zoom-in / .mapboxgl-ctrl-zoom-out / .mapboxgl-ctrl-compass) rather than '.mapboxgl-ctrl-navigation'. Property flip is CSS-hover driven — must .hover() the .flip-card and read computed transform on the child .flip-inner (rotateY(180deg) => matrix3d with -1 in slots 0 and 10). Properties are client-fetched from /api/properties, so wait_for_selector('.flip-card') before asserting count. All three /properties/<slug>, /areas/<slug>, and /areas map instances share data-testid=property-map. Popup link testid is not set; select via '.mapboxgl-popup a[href^="/properties/"]'.

test_results_detail.homepage_load_and_scroll: PASS (no console errors after 2x viewport scroll)
